newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First-Labour talks postponed until Friday.
newsitem.headline: NZ First-Labour talks postponed until Friday.

text.p: Coalition talks between New Zealand First and the Labour Party scheduled for Thursday afteroon have been postponed until Friday due to a backlog of paperwork to be caught up on, NZ First leader Winston Peters said.
Peters said he and Clark had talked about the forward programme for talks with Labour on Friday.

"We have got too much paper work collectively to do to move things through with the speed we should be today. We could do it far better by getting all the paper work done today -- both sides," Peters told Reuters as he left Clark's office.

"After five hours of meetings and other things this morning and knowing that we both have to be on planes -- me to Hamilton Helen Clark to Auckland tonight -- we can't really give it as much time as we would like and it's better to do the whole lot tomorrow," he said.
He said he and Clark had not discussed the talks between Labour and the Alliance.
"That is not a matter on which I have got a central interest," Peters said.
